The '''Model 80 Blaster Pistol''' was a make of [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] produced by the company [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] and sold for 550 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The pistols were bulky, making them heavy and less portable than other smaller [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] pistols, but giving them more stopping power. Due to their weight they were rarely used as backup weapons, but many [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] favored them as primary weapons during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The pistol was considered rugged and dependable by its users and was fairly powerful for a blaster pistol, although not so much as a [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]]. The pistol was built with a stun setting and a scope, the latter of which made it difficult to draw quickly from a holster.<ref name="DC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Model 80 was first shown in ''[[Dangerous Covenants]]'' a sourcebook released in [[2014]] for the ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' roleplaying game produced by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].
